thread:
Kai H: quick heads-up — product wants to ship SIEM exports of redacted auth and infra logs to Splunk this week. need to confirm retention/KMS + who gets query access
Maria L: thanks. do we have an approved redaction pipeline for PII before export? last time we had plain tokens in logs during chat experiments
Jordan P: high level: S3 -> redact lambda -> encrypted-bucket (customer-logs-reduced) -> forwarder -> splunk-hec. KMS used for bucket-level encryption and for the forwarder service key.
sec-bot: Automated audit entry created: REQ-2026-042 - SIEM export request by Kai H. Attached: initial manifest, minimal ACL matrix.
Kai H: @Maria L we were thinking about stripping: user_email, ip_address (last octet kept), device_id. keep uid and event_type. Is that acceptable for compliance?
Maria L: acceptable for prod, need docs. Also require a retention policy: 90 days hot in splunk, 2 years cold archive in encrypted S3, and 7 years for incident-critical subset (legal). Confirm with legal for the 7-year subset.
Jordan P: KMS plan: use a dedicated CMK for SIEM exports with key policy restricting encrypt/decrypt to: forwarder-role, redaction-lambda-role, sec-ops-role (decrypt auditing only). no wildcard principals. sample policy snippet:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Sid": "AllowForwarder", "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/siem-forwarder"}, "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*"}
  ]
}
```
Maria L: also require that any decrypt happens in a VPC-bound job and every decrypt call is logged to our audit table. sec-ops must have read-only decrypt audit role.
SRE Oncall: RBAC for Splunk: we should create role `sec_investigators` and `sec_readers`. investigators get search/export for 90d; readers get search-only for metadata. All access must be requested via infra ticket and 2FA enforced.
Kai H: ok. who owns the infra ticket + IAM changes? @Jordan P?
Jordan P: I'll open an infra-change ticket and include the following tasks: 1) create CMK + key policy 2) update bucket policy to force SSE-KMS 3) deploy redact lambda with tests 4) add Splunk HEC forwarder role 5) create Splunk RBAC roles and map to Okta groups.
Maria L: add a test case: replay a set of synthetic events to verify redaction doesn't break search indices (no removed uid fields). Also include a regression eval for prompt-based logs (we still mask sensitive prompt text).
sec-bot: Policy check: flagged wide IAM allow on `s3:*` in demo bucket — remediation required before export.
Kai H: noted. action list: Jordan opens infra ticket (ETA EOD), Maria to draft retention + redaction doc for legal review (ETA tomorrow), SRE Oncall to propose Splunk RBAC mapping. I'll hold the export until we close infra ticket + legal nod. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: will also add periodic access review cadence (90d) to the ticket.
devops-bot: deploy pipeline queued for redact-lambda (staging) — build #2026.03.12-87
Jordan P: pinging after ticket created: infra-9876, assigned to me. linking this thread to the ticket.
Maria L: thanks everyone — pls add any concerns in the ticket rather than here so we have audit trail.
Kai H: perfect. I'll mark the thread as blocked until infra-9876 is green and legal confirms the 7-year subset.
